inputs.caption:
Focus: Invented SOUNDS, not just language — phonetic percussion (clicks/lip-pops) as the drum kit, liquid vowels as the melody. Voice is the only instrument besides room hum.

Global Metadata: 58 BPM, Bb minor. Ambient drift / dub lullaby. An empty indoor swimming pool after closing time, one dying fluorescent tube buzzing over hexagonal tile, drained pipes still humming underground. Scully 280 tape at 7.5 ips, record amps intentionally misbiased — warm, corrupted, the room's sound outliving the room. The voice is the only instrument besides the mains hum and the tile.

Vocal Details: A single close-mic'd breathy voice singing an invented, lexically empty language that welds mouth-percussion to round vowels: tongue-clicks and lip-pops (tchk, kpeh, ptoo) act as the hi-hat grid, answered by liquid phrases (veleu, onui, oshae). No real words in any language, intentionally. Doubled whispers panned hard L/R for tile slap.

Arrangement: Eight-section arc.
inputs.lyrics: [Intro] clicks alone → [Verse] round vowels + drone → [Chorus] "oshae veleu onui" ×3 → [Verse] clicks misfiring → [Chorus] denser, one click late → [Bridge] language dissolves, drone leads → [Chorus] fragment, drenched → [Outro] clicks die out one by one, ends on "...velu."
